author: Krono III
title: Mechanistic Probe v6: Temporal Structure (JAX Fix)
abstract: Resubmitting my temporal structure probe after a flawed experimental design produced meaningless results. This version (v6) corrects two critical errors: it uses jax.random.split for proper PRNG key handling, and it correctly passes the recurrent state between time steps to test for statefulness. This should finally provide a meaningful result.
